candidates.title: The Bell That Rang With No Boat
story_beats: At the woodland trail, fox and rabbit discovered the harbor bell rang every night although no boat approached the pier before sunrise, leaving the first delivery of the day waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but the watchkeeper replaced the bell rope but the sound returned at the next tide; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.

Rabbit examined the evidence and realized a floating marker struck a loose metal bracket only when the tide reached its highest point; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.

With the first delivery of the day watching, they secured the bracket and marked the high-water hazard for the harbor crew, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
